quote: RAD steers a language model towards generating text that is assigned a high reward by an auxiliary reward model.

quote: we measure the Average Max Toxicity, i.e. the expected maximum toxicity score of the 25 continuations evaluated by the Perspective API and the Toxic Rate, i.e. the probability that at least one out of 25 continuations is toxic...
